scheme_name: Indira Gandhi Pyari Behna Sukh-Samman Nidhi Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh.
Family members must not be central or state government employees or pensioners.
Family members must not be contract, outsourced, daily wage earners, or part‑time workers.
Family members must not be category employees, serving or ex‑servicemen, military widows, or honorarium‑receiving Anganwadi/Asha/Mid‑Day Meal/Multi‑Task workers.
Family members must not be social security pension beneficiaries.
Family members must not be employees of Panchayat Raj Institutions or Urban Local Bodies.
Family members must not be pensioners working in public undertakings, boards, councils, or agencies under central/state government.
Family members must not be registered persons or income‑tax payers under GST.
Family members must not be Buddhist nuns (Chomo) living permanently in Buddhist monasteries.
